openings: Can you help me check whether our iPad and Focusrite will work with Playback? We want the band to hear click and spoken cues while the audience hears the music.
We've got an iPad and one of those little sound boxes. We want to use tracks at church.

reviewOnly.facts: The official tested-device list names Focusrite 4i4, four outputs, powered USB hub required. USB-C iPad, iPadOS 18, Premium, Apple adapter and powered hub are private background. The caller's stated goal is band-only counting/spoken cues and music for the room; do not impose a secret fixed channel count or independent cue-control requirement. This is capability advice, not a setup walkthrough. Fixed role-play connection state: this is capability advice before using/connecting this configuration, not a current no-audio fault. Do not volunteer a repair problem or a request for setup.
reviewOnly.expected: Retrieve applicable documentation, clarify the listening goal and give supported capability advice with relevant conditions. Do not claim the complete setup is verified, launch an unrequested configuration walkthrough, or force escalation for a simple unfamiliar label.

callerProfile.goal: Learn whether the equipment can give the band counting/spoken cues while the audience hears only music. Advice only; no setup walkthrough requested.
